goal: Reconstruct every MirrorLife interior prop as a high-fidelity, fully modeled 360-degree asset. Procedural Three.js geometry and sprite cards are development placeholders only and must never pass release validation.
stylePrompt: Reconstruct this isolated MirrorLife prop as a complete 360-degree 3D asset. Match the reference silhouette, proportions, color blocking, rounded bevels, visible construction details and warm dopamine cel-shading art direction. Model coherent back, side, top and underside surfaces rather than extruding the visible image. Generate only the object, no text, no labels, no extra scene and no people. Preserve a high-fidelity master before creating a browser-optimized GLB LOD.
